story_note: Isla takes her puzzle to the bookshop cafe, where the Thursday morning crowd provides a gentle backdrop to a tricky mid-week grid.
continuation_note: Unlike the quiet window desk sessions of the past two days, today Isla works in a busier environment and encounters a different kind of stuck moment—briefly second-guessing an entry rather than just pausing to think.
facebook_post_text: Thursday morning at the bookshop with a trickier grid than expected. https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk

style_rules: Isla is the only active daily comic character.
Use ISLA_SP trigger word in every image prompt.
Young Black woman, warm medium brown skin, light freckles on nose and cheeks.
Natural coily dark hair in high voluminous puff bun.
Wide floral headband in teal, rust orange, cream, and dusty blue, worn across forehead.
At least 2 of the 6 panels must be front-facing or three-quarter view showing Isla's face clearly.
Puzzle screen must come from a real captured puzzle page.
